target_basis.quantity: 95% CL UL on $\sigma(pp\to Z')\times B(Z'\to WW)$ [pb]
target_basis.model: HVT DY-produced Z' -> WW (13 TeV); limits are model-independent sigma x BR on DY production
target_basis.notes: the ask: sensitivity below 500 GeV; window drawn 150-1000 GeV to show the floor. REACH vs COVERAGE (2026-07-08): limit curves reach down to 200 GeV, but the HVT Model A theory prediction is only carried at m>=800 GeV (ATLAS_2004.14636's two digitized theory points, 800/1000 GeV) -- by design, not an oversight. This summary does NOT support reading 'is Model A excluded at 300 GeV' directly off the plot; that would require a theory curve at 300 GeV, which this survey does not carry.

curves.kind: obs+exp (theory intentionally not carried on this curve -- redundant with the ATLAS_2004.14636 curve's own HVT Model A reference line, already drawn; keeps the legend to one theory entry, avoiding plot-lint legend-occlusion clutter; numerically cross-checked in identity_check below)
curves.native_basis: sigma_X x B(X->WW) 95% CL UL [pb] vs m_X [GeV] -- digitized from figures/Limit_HVT.pdf (the ggF/DY HVT limit panel; the VBF-only Limit_HVT_VBF.pdf was NOT used). No HEPData aux data file was found: outputs/published/atlas_1710.01123/1710.01123.tar.gz is the arXiv LaTeX source tarball (figures/ subfolder of PDFs only, no HEPData yaml/dat/csv), and the paper's HEPData table names carry no WW/HVT/limit keyword (the original mechanical-drop reason, F1). Digitized by pixel-calibrating the rasterized PDF (Ghostscript 400dpi): axis frame + major tick pixel positions fit a linear x(mass)/log y(sigma) map, then observed-curve marker/line pixels read off column-by-column after masking the legend/text box and axis-tick bands.
curves.transformation: IDENTITY (already the target basis; native pb & GeV, no unit conversion)
curves.identity_check: SUMMARY-reach digitization, approximate not precision (per the task's explicit allowance): (a) the extracted HVT g_V=1 theory line at m=1000 GeV reads 0.232 pb, vs the independently-digitized ATLAS_2004.14636 curve's theory value of 0.23 pb at the same mass -- same model (HVT Model A g_V=1), <1% agreement, cross-validates the pixel calibration; (b) all 24 digitized observed mass/sigma points were overlaid back onto the source raster as markers and visually confirmed landing on the plotted curve (QA overlay tracked at plots/qa_1710.01123_digitize_overlay.png); (c) expected and theory series are digitized only where the dashed/red line was unambiguously resolvable pixel-by-pixel (legend/label-box masked) -- points not confidently resolved are left null rather than interpolated or fabricated.
curves.correction_2026_07_11: first digitized point relabeled 200->250 GeV: the paper text (1710.01123 Sec. limits) states qqA HVT limits are derived FROM 250 GeV; a 200 GeV point cannot exist on Figure 11a. Found during the PROJ run's figure-contract declaration (D7).

coverage_gaps.note: no published Z'->WW limit below 200 GeV (fully-leptonic ATLAS 1710.01123 floor)
